page.overview:
Who is Archibald?

Archibald is a high paladin in Othanzia who has not yet appeared on Critical Role. After acquiring a Horn of Orcus from K'Varn's corpse, Vox Machina returned to Emon, where Vox Machina sought the help of the Tal'Dorei Council. At the meeting, Kima of Vord suggested that the horn be resealed with the help of paladin Archibald:
